title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1254: Number one pretty boy (2)

section.p: Xia Longwu was in no rush. He continued looking around.

Soon, his gaze landed on a certain someone. He smiled. Further away, Marquis Xia was gasping for breath in exhaustion. He did not dare to approach, but when he met Xia Longwu’s gaze, he nodded with an unsightly expression.
Xia Longwu sighed. So his teacher had still taken that step? He had been able to guess his teacher’s plans. His teacher had departed. Perhaps he would never return to the Human Realm again.
So be it.
Now, his teacher would be safe.

The human and myriad race Invincibles were all here. Everyone was too occupied to pay attention to what his teacher was doing. He looked at the surrounding human Invincibles and smiled in amusement. Were they aware?
Perhaps some were.
Whatever.

Almost all human Invincibles in existence were here. However, the myriad race Invincibles were at least twice their number. There were over a hundred of them here. Thankfully, a decent number of them had died or lost their tri-life bodies. That had thinned their number considerably.
Xia Longwu, who had been remaining relatively silent all along, suddenly laughed and said, “My dao affirmation feels a lot more respectable than even my martial uncle, Ye Batian’s dao affirmation.”
Great Xia King was stunned by that. The other Invincibles also looked over. Xia Longwu had rarely mentioned Ye Batian.

At about sixty, he was similar in age to people like Liu Wenyan. Thus, he was old enough to have seen Ye Batian. Of course, he was still too young back then. And his teacher wasn’t Ye Batian. If Ye Batian had survived, he would have ended up as Ye Batian’s student as well.
Unfortunately, Ye Batian had died when Xia Longwu was only a teenager. At that age, he had yet to take on a teacher. Eventually, he became Wan Tiansheng’s student.
At the time, Wan Tiansheng was regarded as a genius peak Mountainsea.
Why did he mention Ye Batian suddenly?
Xia Longwu said, “I have taken countless lives in the Allheaven Battlefield. I deserve this hostility from the myriad races.”
He looked at the human Invincibles and smiled, “Everyone, leave. Let them through. I wish to see if I can kill a few Invincibles before dying like my martial uncle.”
Great Xia King chided furiously, “Nonsense! Like your martial uncle? What bullshit!”
There were over a hundred Invincibles here. How was he supposed to do that?
Great Xia King started roaring madly, “You killed my eldest son. You slaughtered my people in Great Xia. If you dare to kill my grandson, a blood feud will start between us.”
He looked at the other human Invincibles, gnashed his teeth, and said, “My friends, help me this one time. Longwu…he…”
Great Qin King nodded and said, “Don’t worry. As I said, they would need to step over our dead bodies before they are allowed to lay a hand on him.”

Qin Zhen had completed his dao affirmation. As long as there was still an Invincible in Great Qin, their great army would remain orderly. With Great Qin in order, humanity would still be able to maintain its power in the Allheaven Battlefield.

Thus, Great Qin King could fight with nothing to worry about anymore. As for whether the Human Realm would sink into chaos, that was something for Great Zhou King to worry about. Great Qin King did not know if Great Zhou King could do it. Perhaps Great Zhou King would be even better at this job than him.
Xia Longwu said nothing else. His grandfather’s plea for help wouldn’t achieve much. There were over a hundred Invincibles arrayed against them. That was pointless.

At the same time, Su Yu had just stepped through the portal in the Allheaven Prefecture. Right after he emerged at the other side, he triggered his mayor’s medallion. Moments later, a spatial tunnel appeared on the horizon, extending toward the portal.
The human Invincible guarding the place noted the incoming tunnel and roared in fury.
As a response, Su Yu soared into the sky and soothed, “Mayor of Grandstar City, Su Yu, is passing through. I seek your understanding, Invincible.”
After hearing those words, the Invincible withdrew with an odd expression on his face. Then, Su Yu stepped into the tunnel and started heading toward the Sea of Stars.
He crossed the Eastrift Valley, traversed the Plain of Desires, and stepped over the Heavendoom City, angering the jealous mayor Tian He, and attracting Heavendoom’s attention.
Heavendoom was displeased with how much Grandstar was indulging Su Yu.
Not a single guardian had indulged their mayor so much before. Damn it! He even opened a spatial tunnel for his mayor to traverse! Would it kill Su Yu for him to fly slowly like a normal person?

As Su Yu was stepping over Heavendoom City, the jealous stone statue sent him a voice transmission, “Kid, have you forgotten me after receiving my breathing technique, vibration technique, and teleportation talismans?”

Su Yu laughed in amusement as he cupped his fists at the city, “Please forgive me, Lord Heavendoom. I am now a part of Grandstar City. If you have any needs, you are welcomed to seek me out. I’ll be glad to serve.”

Damn it! Heavendoom grew even more jealous at the reminder that the kid had joined Grandstar City. Damn that kid! Served him right for having so much death qi in his body. He wouldn’t live long with that much death qi in him.
How was he even alive?
Seemingly in response to Heavendoom’s thoughts, Su Yu demonstrated his ability to reverse death qi into source qi.
Then, he nonchalantly moved away from the city.
Heavendoom: “…”
Heavendoom was so infuriated he felt like smashing the kid apart with his tail. What was the meaning of that? Was the kid showing off? The damn kid was definitely showing off!
Damn it!

How dare the kid provoke him! That was definitely deliberate! Heavendoom was furious. Was the kid trying to say that he wouldn’t die? Was the kid telling him that Grandstar would still be able to continue running around outside the city?

Heavendoom was furious. He had the urge to give Tian He a beating. Yes, he should give Tian He a beating instead of Su Yu. After all, that was someone else’s mayor. It would be inappropriate for him to beat someone else’s mayor. Meanwhile, Tian He was planning to resign. It would be fine for him to take out his anger on Tian He, right?
At this point, Su Yu was already gone.
Inside the city, Mayor Tian He was sulking. He wanted to be such a glorious mayor as well.
Damn it!
His guardian was personally helping him cross the Allheaven Battlefield. How glorious was that? From how he was traveling, one would think that he was even more important than Invincibles.

Sure enough, fate was unfair. Apart from sitting there acting all cool and fierce, Heavendoom had done nothing for his mayor. Unlike Grandstar, Heavendoom had never offered his mayor a ride across the Allheaven Battlefield.
Before long, Su Yu had completely forgotten about Heavendoom City.
He continued his journey.
He was near the Sea of Stars.

There, countless Invincibles were gathered. Noticing his presence, they all looked in his direction. He ignored them. Some of the Invincibles gnashed their teeth. They had a strong urge to blast him apart. They really wanted to crush that spatial tunnel.

Right at that moment, a voice rang out, “Su Yu is my mayor. The holy cities have our own ways of doing things. We don’t like causing trouble, but we don’t fear trouble. The thirty-six guardians are always ready for battle. Do you dare bully my mayor?”
In the sky, Su Yu looked at the Invincibles and laughed.

He addressed the many Invincibles arrogantly, “Su Yu of the ancient city does not intend to provoke anyone. I’m merely passing by. There is no need for you to look at me with so much hostility. I have the favor of the thirty-six lord guardians. If you don’t care about the thirty-six guardians, you are free to kill me.”

Should they do it? Should they offend thirty-six Invincibles to kill Su Yu? Thirty-six ancient Invincibles, not regular Invincibles. They really wanted to kill Su Yu, but they ultimately gave up on killing him.
So be it. Su Yu was already the hegemon of a region. That was something they had to live with.

Su Yu looked at Xia Longwu, Great Qin King, and the others. However, he did not stop as he continued heading toward the ancient city. Great Qin King and the others saw him as well. Some of them sighed inwardly.
Su Yu!

This young genius of the multiple character faction had not done well in the Human Realm. But he had done exceptionally well in the Allheaven Battlefield. Here, he had earned the backing of the strongest faction: the ancient cities.
As for the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion, it was merely the second strongest faction in the Allheaven Battlefield. The various major realms were not considered Allheaven Battlefield factions.
Someone sent Great Xia King a voice transmission, “Great Xia King, should we…get Su Yu to help?”

Su Yu’s backers were very powerful. Those were thirty-six ancient Invincibles they were talking about. In the past, a lot of people believed that those stone statues were mere statues. But now, everyone knew that the stone statues were actually alive. They were simply unconcerned about the affairs of the mundane world.
Each of these stone statues had the strength to fight against multiple Invincibles alone. And if they were provoked enough, they would certainly fight. That was a terrifying faction.

Thanks to their backing, the public enemy number one was able to openly fly past them. Over a hundred Invincibles were forced to watch and do nothing. It was evident how powerful the stone statues were.
If they must kill Su Yu, they had to do it somewhere the stone statues couldn’t reach.

Xia Longwu also looked at Su Yu. When he saw Su Yu leaving, he smiled. He did not mind Su Yu’s departure. What an interesting kid. Was the kid making this journey to take a look at him? Or was the kid here to laugh at him?
Whatever. The kid had his own path to walk.

At that moment, Xia Longwu’s aura finally started changing. He was ready to complete his fusion. The human Invincibles wouldn’t be able to do much to protect him. Before long, the myriad race Invincibles would start splitting the battlefield. Even if the myriad race Invincibles didn’t do so, the human Invincibles would do it.
Otherwise, the shockwaves from the battle between over a hundred Invincibles would be enough to kill him.

Thus, the outnumbered human Invincibles would be kept occupied in the alternate dimensions by a part of the myriad race Invincibles while the rest would be free to go after him. He was only dragging this out to allow more humans to affirm their dao.

At that moment, someone walked out of the Human Realm’s entrance. He laughed heartily and said, “Some of you need to be here. Three or five won’t do. You’ll need at least ten to keep watch on me. If you do that, I won’t be able to affirm my dao. If not, I’ll affirm my dao. See, I have my carrier treasure with me.”
It was Zhu Tiandao.
He appeared completely fearless.
His voice spread everywhere.
“Come on. Stop wasting time.”
The Invincible guarding the entrance was personally helping spread his voice all over the Allheaven Battlefield. Before long, his voice was heard by the myriad race Invincibles.
Zhu Tiandao!
The person who had shone the brightest today!

He didn’t even need to say much. Moments after hearing his words, about seven or eight Invincibles started rushing toward the eastern sector of the Allheaven Battlefield. Zhu Tiandao was right. The myriad races could tolerate his existence as long as he remained a Sunmoon. However, they wouldn’t allow him to affirm his dao.

Of course, they were only rushing over to prevent him from affirming his dao. They did not intend to actually kill him since he could easily flee back to the Human Realm. Zhu Tiandao boasted arrogantly, “Only seven or eight of you? Are you looking down on me? With only this number, are you not afraid of getting killed by me instead?”
Everyone ignored him.

They still doubted his feat of slaying four Invincibles. He wasn’t even that injured, as though he hadn’t been in that intense of a fight. Unless he was a Pseudo Emperor, it was very unlikely for him to be strong enough to kill four Invincibles.
